term: complete unchanged forwarding of a present indexed input
definition: For every n and j, if immediate upstream output signal(n+1) is some(j), then output signal(n) is that same some(j). No present admitted input can be erased, overwritten or relabeled at a station.
note: This all-station persistence interface is stronger than merely having active/passive capacities or an incoming causal edge. PGR maintenance motivates a conditional reading; the later signal revision alone does not explicitly establish this complete numeric transition rule. Closed input/output alphabet, no interference, countable patchwork and real-system application remain OPEN.
